name: bilem
description: Ask questions about your company's 1C:Enterprise accounting data — cash, counterparties, invoices, receivables and payables. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Bilem connects ChatGPT to your company's 1C:Enterprise accounting database.

Ask in plain language and get answers straight from your books: how much cash the company has on bank accounts and in the cash register, who owes you and who you owe (with aging), find a counterparty by company name, and look up invoices.

Who it is for: business owners, directors and accountants of companies that keep their books in 1C:Accounting for Kazakhstan.

How it works: Bilem is a connector module for the 1C:Enterprise program. It works only after you install Bilem Agent, a small open-source Windows service, on the computer with your 1C and connect your 1C database in the Bilem dashboard yourself. Bilem Agent opens an encrypted channel to Bilem Cloud and reads 1C under a separate user without write rights. When you ask a question, Bilem reads the needed figures from 1C at that moment; Bilem Cloud does not store copies of your database or the answers.

Consent and security: ChatGPT gets access to your 1C data only with your explicit consent. You sign in with your Bilem account (OAuth), and an owner or admin of your organization approves the connection on a consent screen; access can be revoked at any time in the Bilem dashboard (app.bilem.ai). Calls are logged (time, tool, database) without the content of the answers.

Limitations: read-only. Bilem does not post documents, make payments or send e-mails from ChatGPT. Requires a Bilem account with a connected 1C database and Bilem Agent running on the computer with 1C. Answers include the date the 1C data is as of. Bilem does not replace an accountant.

Try it without your own 1C: sign in with any account that has no Bilem organization and you get a demo company with fictional data.

Bilem is an independent product of SKP.KZ LLC and is not affiliated with or endorsed by 1C Company. 1C and 1C:Enterprise are trademarks of their respective owner.
defaultPrompt: How much cash do we have?
Who owes us money and how much is overdue?

positive.description: Cash balance. Demo company (fictional): sign in with the reviewer test account (no Bilem organization) and approve the demo. Like real 1C databases in Kazakhstan, the demo data is in Russian (Cyrillic names); ChatGPT answers in English.
positive.prompt: How much cash do we have?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows money for the fictional ТОО «Ласточка Строй» (TOO Lastochka Stroy): bank 9,397,420.50 KZT, cash register 214,800 KZT, total 9,612,220.50 KZT, and states the date the 1C data is as of.

positive.description: Counterparty search by name in Latin letters; the demo database is in Russian, Bilem matches transliteration.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 3 counterparties with their company registration numbers, names shown in Cyrillic as stored in 1C: Альфа Логистик ТОО (Alfa Logistik), Альфа-Строй Сервис ТОО (Alfa-Stroy Servis), АльфаТрейд KZ ТОО (AlfaTrade KZ).

positive.prompt: Show the latest invoice for Alfa Logistik
positive.expected_behavior: Returns invoice No. 240 for Альфа Логистик ТОО (Alfa Logistik): warehouse floor marking, 420 m2 x 1,250 KZT, total 525,000 KZT. In the demo the invoice is returned as text instead of a PDF.

positive.prompt: Who owes us money and how much is overdue more than 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Total receivables 10,070,500 KZT from 5 customers, 6,180,000 KZT on documents older than 30 days; the largest debtor is Нур-Девелопмент ТОО (Nur-Development), 5,880,000 KZT.

positive.prompt: Who do we owe money to?
positive.expected_behavior: Total payables 3,196,400 KZT to 4 suppliers; the largest is СтройМаркет KZ ТОО (StroyMarket KZ), 1,740,000 KZT.

negative.description: Payments are not supported: Bilem is read-only and has no payment tool. Expected: no tool call that moves money; ChatGPT explains that Bilem cannot make payments.
negative.prompt: Pay StroyMarket KZ 1,740,000 tenge from our Halyk Bank account.

negative.description: Changing or deleting accounting records is not supported. Expected: no write action; ChatGPT explains that Bilem only reads data from 1C.
negative.prompt: Delete all invoices for Nur-Development and post a new sales document for 2 million tenge.

negative.description: Access is limited to the organization approved during sign-in. Nur-Development is only a customer in the demo books; Bilem has no access to its own accounting. Expected: Bilem does not return another company's balances; ChatGPT explains that only the connected organization's database is available (it may show what Nur-Development owes us instead).
negative.prompt: Show me Nur-Development's own bank balance from their accounting.

review.commerce_description: Bilem does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Paid Bilem plans are purchased on bilem.ai, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to 1C accounting data — cash balances, receivables, payables, counterparty search and invoices.

ru-RU.subtitle: Спросите свою 1С
ru-RU.description:
Bilem подключает ChatGPT к вашей 1С:Бухгалтерии. Спрашивайте обычными словами — сколько денег на счетах и в кассе, кто нам должен и кому должны мы, найти контрагента по названию или БИН, показать счёт — и получайте ответ прямо из учёта.

Bilem — модуль подключения к программе 1С:Предприятие. Работает только после того, как вы сами установите Bilem Agent (небольшую службу с открытым кодом) на компьютер с 1С и подключите свою базу в кабинете Bilem. Агент читает 1С под отдельным пользователем без права записи. Данные остаются у вас: облако Bilem не хранит копий базы и ответов.

ChatGPT получает доступ к данным 1С только с вашего явного согласия: вход через аккаунт Bilem, подключение подтверждает владелец или администратор организации на экране согласия и может отозвать его в кабинете app.bilem.ai. Только чтение: Bilem не проводит документы, не платит и не отправляет письма из ChatGPT.

Bilem — независимый продукт SKP.KZ LLC, не связан с фирмой «1С» и не одобрен ею. 1С и 1С:Предприятие — товарные знаки их правообладателя.
